name: judger
description: Makes judging, compiling, and downloading problems for competitve programming easy. Also supports auto-submit for a few sites.

judger.general.menuChoices.default: cpp java js python c rust ruby csharp go haskell

judger.general.includeProblemIndex.description: Include the problem index for problem file generated ( like P_1_abc ) instead of omitting it

judger.general.wordRegex.description: The regex that defines what a word is for problem file generated. Each word is separated by an underscore

judger.general.doTemplateFileVariableRep.description: Replace $var$ in the template file with its value. For example, replace $url$ with the problem's url. For more information, please refer to the user guide.

judger.general.hideOutputDifference.description: If true, the UI will hide the inline output difference by default. Users can toggle and this will be remembered.

ojName.description: OJ full name used for {ojName} placeholder

contestIdRegex.description: Optional regex to extract contestId from URL. First capture group is used.

problemIdRegex.description: Optional regex to extract problemId from URL. First capture group is used.

problemSource.description: Optional problem page source for this OJ. Falls back to Default Problem Source.

urlTemplate.description: Template to reconstruct original OJ URL. Use {contestId} and {problemId} placeholders.

problemIdRegex.description: Optional: regex to split VJudge's combined problem ID. Capture group 1 → {contestId}, group 2 → {problemId}.

compositeFormat.description: Optional: template to reconstruct composite problem ID for VJudge URL. Defaults to '{contestId}{problemId}'. Use when VJudge uses a separator (e.g. '{contestId}_{problemId}' for AtCoder).

vjudgeUrlKey.description: Optional: override the VJudge URL OJ name. When this entry is matched but the VJudge URL uses a different key (e.g. 'CF' maps to 'CodeForces', 'Luogu' maps to '洛谷'), specify the canonical key here.

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run webpack-frontend-production && npm run webpack-production
scripts.pretest: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('out', { recursive: true, force: true })" && tsc -p ./
